description: Get the current time. No arguments = UTC in ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-23T08:00:00Z. {"local": true} = the local time of this machine with its UTC offset and weekday, e.g. 2026-11-13T21:30:00+08:00 Friday (the time clock_register at and cron use).

local.description: true = local time of this machine with UTC offset and weekday instead of UTC
